production_pdf_reason: No press-ready PDF was generated because the finished-size/artboard conflict is unresolved, the back legal net-content copy is unapproved, and the supplied flattened RGB preview is insufficient for 300 dpi production at the stated size.

checks.method: SHA-256 digest and read-only source handling
file, sips and Pillow metadata inspection
checks.result: 1376×768 px, 8-bit RGB PNG, 300 dpi metadata, no embedded ICC profile; flattened front/back presentation board.

checks.method: Visual bounding-box measurement on the flattened preview
checks.result: Front approximately 492×501 px and back approximately 493×501 px; near-square geometry is incompatible with 120×200 mm trim.

A 120×200 mm trim with 3 mm bleed requires approximately 1488×2433 px per side at 300 dpi. Scaling the approximate front region to 120×200 mm would yield about 104×64 ppi and distort its aspect ratio.

checks.method: Trim/bleed arithmetic across both supplied notes
checks.result: 120×200 mm trim plus 3 mm bleed on every edge yields 126×206 mm. If 125×205 mm is trim, its bleed page is 131×211 mm; if it includes bleed, its trim is 119×199 mm. No interpretation matches the client note.
Back legal net-content wording is not confirmed. Existing front text '250 g' was not treated as approval or copied to the back.
Input is untagged RGB and no factory CMYK ICC profile or total ink limit was supplied.

checks.method: pdfinfo and direct PDF object inspection
checks.result: Two A4 landscape pages, 841.92×595.2 pt; each page contains one 3508×2480 DeviceCMYK image and no DeviceRGB image, equivalent to 300 dpi.

checks.method: Poppler render at 150 dpi followed by visual inspection
checks.result: Both pages render legibly with no clipping, overlap, missing glyphs or broken layout; non-production warning is prominent.
Not applicable because the production PDF was intentionally withheld. The report PDF is an A4 document and is not claimed to contain packaging TrimBox/BleedBox.

unresolved_blockers: Factory confirmation of whether 125×205 mm is trim or total artboard, plus the official dieline/template.
Client approval of the exact back legal net-content copy and compliance requirements.
Separated vector artwork or high-resolution per-side production masters matching the confirmed dieline.
Factory CMYK ICC profile and total ink coverage requirement, or explicit approval of a named standard profile.
